jobDescription: Title: Analyst, Oracle EBS Software Assurance Position Details: We are looking for an experienced Oracle EBS Analyst who is well versed in testing and validation of Oracle EBS systems. Experience with Oracle EBS R12 modules: Manufacturing, Order Management, Service, Finance, WMS. Working knowledge of data migration, sampling methods, test approaches, and overall process Experience working on large projects (upgrades, migrations, mergers) is a plus. Experience with 3rd party vendor integrations with ERP System. Ability to create technical documentation, analyze and translate requirements and user stories into test scripts.
